name: Phnom Penh International Half Marathon
short_description: A half marathon (21.1 km) plus 10 km and 5 km options held in Phnom Penh, Cambodia on June 13, 2027.
ai_summary: The Phnom Penh International Half Marathon is scheduled for June 13, 2027, in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, organized by Cambodia Events. Registration has not yet been announced.
